datasets.name: ds_kpi
queryLines: SELECT
(SELECT AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_gsd) AS gsd_rate,
(SELECT AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_ked) AS ked_rate,
(SELECT AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_bpd) AS bpd_rate,
(SELECT AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_spd) AS spd_rate,
(SELECT AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_eed) AS eed_rate

datasets.name: ds_rates
queryLines: SELECT 'GSD' AS measure, AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS eligible FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_gsd
UNION ALL SELECT 'KED', AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)), COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_ked
UNION ALL SELECT 'BPD', AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)), COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_bpd
UNION ALL SELECT 'SPD', AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)), COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_spd
UNION ALL SELECT 'EED', AVG(CAST(numerator_flag AS INT)), COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_eed

datasets.name: ds_status
queryLines: SELECT 'GSD' AS measure, status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_gsd GROUP BY status
UNION ALL SELECT 'KED', status, COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_ked GROUP BY status
UNION ALL SELECT 'BPD', status, COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_bpd GROUP BY status
UNION ALL SELECT 'SPD', status, COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_spd GROUP BY status
UNION ALL SELECT 'EED', status, COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_eed GROUP BY status

datasets.name: ds_gap_summary
queryLines: SELECT measure, gap_reason, COUNT(*) AS patients FROM (
SELECT 'GSD' AS measure, 'No A1c test in year' AS gap_reason FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_gsd WHERE status='NOT_MET'

UNION ALL SELECT 'KED', CASE WHEN NOT egfr_flag AND NOT uacr_flag THEN 'No eGFR and no uACR' WHEN NOT uacr_flag THEN 'No uACR test' ELSE 'No eGFR test' END FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_ked WHERE status='NOT_MET'
UNION ALL SELECT 'BPD', 'BP not controlled / no reading' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_bpd WHERE status='NOT_MET'
UNION ALL SELECT 'SPD', 'No statin dispensed' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_spd WHERE status='NOT_MET'
UNION ALL SELECT 'EED', 'No diabetic eye exam' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_eed WHERE status='NOT_MET'
) GROUP BY measure, gap_reason ORDER BY patients DESC

datasets.name: ds_gaps
queryLines: SELECT 'GSD' AS measure, patient_id, age, 'No A1c test in year' AS gap_reason FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_gsd WHERE status='NOT_MET'

UNION ALL SELECT 'KED', patient_id, age, CASE WHEN NOT egfr_flag AND NOT uacr_flag THEN 'No eGFR and no uACR' WHEN NOT uacr_flag THEN 'No uACR test' ELSE 'No eGFR test' END FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_ked WHERE status='NOT_MET'
UNION ALL SELECT 'BPD', patient_id, age, 'BP not controlled / no reading' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_bpd WHERE status='NOT_MET'
UNION ALL SELECT 'SPD', patient_id, age, 'No statin dispensed' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_spd WHERE status='NOT_MET'
UNION ALL SELECT 'EED', patient_id, age, 'No diabetic eye exam' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_eed WHERE status='NOT_MET'
ORDER BY measure, age DESC
